text: Waiting on the review verdict (background run `bdbg7irnn`) before merging the session-naming fix — fallback wakeup set for 20 minutes. I'll report back once it lands or needs another fix.

Task landed. Summary:

**Root cause:** `AISessionDetail.content()` and `log_urls()` gated SessionWork's `ready` promise (which `SessionStats`, `SessionOutlineView`, and `SessionOverview` all wait on), `SessionTasks`, and `AISessionCoverage` behind a uuid-shaped-id check meant only for the Claude-Code transcript tail. A voice session's id (`v-9dvbbrn`) never matches a uuid, so `ready` never resolved — Overview stuck reading forever, Timeline stuck on "no events," Tasks/Board/Coverage empty, and the stats bar rendered as an empty *unhidden* strip (the reported sliver) instead of hiding itself as designed.

**Fix:** use the page's already-known dated folder (`segs`) instead of requiring a uuid; only the transcript tail still needs one. Follow-up commit stopped a newly-surfaced side effect (a 400 from asking `/ai-logs/` for a voice session's nonexistent transcript).

**The More dropdown** is a `ux/Popover` menu (role `dialog`, skinned `sessions-pop`), wrapped by `SessionPopover`. It never closed on a second tap: the native `popover="auto"` box light-dismisses on `pointerdown` before the click handler's `toggle()` ran, so it reopened instead of closing — which is also why Board/Coverage "did nothing": those panels were just permanently blank from the same root cause, not broken clicks.

**Verified headless (Playwright):** Overview shows 2 child sessions/23 tasks, Timeline 229 events, Board/Coverage populate, popover opens→closes→reopens correctly; a small uuid-based session (`session-012f0067`) is unchanged. Smoke clean, 121 tests green, merged to `michael/dev` (`f4e929097`, `d04b90a56`).
Landing line appended and the card updated. Task is fully closed out: fix merged to `michael/dev` (commits `f4e929097`, `d04b90a56`), task record completed with evidence, owner card replied.

Acknowledged in the log — clarity's rewrite was a clean word-count trim with no content loss (the dropped detail is still in the two named commits), and I declined to re-shoot screens since the fix was already proven live with headless Playwright (Overview, Timeline, Board, Coverage all populated; popover toggling correctly; a small uuid session unaffected), already listed as evidence on the task. Task `session-page-overview-timeline-and-tasks` remains complete — nothing further queued.

**Landed.** Voice session naming fix merged to `michael/dev` (commit `202bc1803`):

- **Root cause fixed:** the "no session undefined" bug — session id now comes from the calling agent's own identity, never the model-typed argument.
- **Live retitling:** `session_summary`/`rename_session` retitle sessions in place; the Switch-session dropdown now actually redraws on a title change (review round 2 caught that the event was pushed but nothing read it — fixed by wiring `owner.broadcast()` in `chat.js`).
- **Untitled sessions** show their voice id as the label, per the owner's own later reversal of the content-based-fallback ask — pushed back on that review finding with the quote.
- **Deviation reported, not hidden:** the dropdown title and the session's folder name no longer match (folder stays `v-xxxxxxx` forever) — a real folder-rename was built, found unsafe by review (it breaks the smart assistant's own item-tool path), and dropped. Posted as an [owner_note](/framework/ai/2026/10/25/voice-session-dropdown-title-and-its-fol/) plus a gap note in `core/Item/readme.md`.
- Resolved a real merge conflict by hand: a sibling task had landed a different `session_switcher` redesign on `michael/dev` while this branch was out; resynced onto it and replayed only the two non-overlapping additions.
- Backfilled `requirements.md`, an outcome line, and a screenshot that review round 2 found missing; answered all 8 of its findings in the task log; self-verified round 2's fixes rather than spawning a third paid review (week is 113% of pace).
- Worktree torn down and removed; task marked complete.

Not built on purpose: a general item-level rename-with-reference-update (`core/Item/readme.md`), and a rename-proposal card (logged at `ai/todo.md`).
